name: autoprint
description: AutoPrint prints your existing artwork and photos on wall art, apparel, and personalized gifts. Supply a public image link and describe the product or size you want. AutoPrint prepares that artwork without generating a replacement and gives you a studio link to preview the product, choose a size, and order on the website. Products include posters, framed prints, canvas, t-shirts, hoodies, tote bags, pillows, phone cases, and puzzles. The MCP connector does not generate images, place orders, or take payment. AutoPrint’s website also lets you upload files or create new artwork.

positive.expected_behavior: Calls start_design with the supplied artwork_url and requested print. Checks the returned ID until ready, shows the existing artwork, and gives the studio link to preview the product, choose a size, and order. Does not generate an image.
